pages.text: $(item)Pale Ale$(): pale malt. $(item)Amber Ale$(): a quarter amber or more. $(item)Stout$(): a quarter black. $(item)Old Ale$(): strong, with amber; it ages. $(item)Wheat Beer$(): half wheat malt.
$(item)Lager$(): pale, fermented Cold with Lager Yeast. $(item)Plain Ale$(): no hops. Anything else is $(item)Table Beer$(), so nothing is ever wasted.
